description: Master Catalog and Registry of Climate, Satellite, Ocean, and Hydrological Data Endpoints and Resources

data_sources.name: Copernicus Climate Data Store (CDS) - ERA5T & ERA5 Reanalysis
data_sources.latency: Near-real-time (~5 days latency for ERA5T; consolidated into ERA5 after ~3 months)

data_sources.name: NOAA Climate Prediction Center - Oceanic Niño Index (ONI)
data_sources.description: Standard sea surface temperature anomaly index for monitoring El Niño and La Niña phases.

data_sources.name: NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory - Indian Ocean Dipole (DMI)
data_sources.agency: NOAA PSL / UK Met Office Hadley Centre
data_sources.spatial_resolution: Dipole Mode Index (Western vs Eastern Tropical Indian Ocean SST gradient)
data_sources.description: Indian Ocean Dipole Mode Index computed from HadISST SST datasets.

data_sources.name: Tropical Northern Atlantic Index (TNA)
data_sources.description: Anomalies of the average monthly sea surface temperature in the North Tropical Atlantic.

data_sources.name: Tropical Southern Atlantic Index (TSA)
data_sources.description: Anomalies of the average monthly sea surface temperature in the South Tropical Atlantic.

data_sources.name: Atlantic Multidecadal Oscillation (AMO)
data_sources.description: Detrended sea surface temperature anomaly series for the North Atlantic basin.

data_sources.name: NOAA CPC African Rainfall Estimation (RFE 2.0 / ARC2)
data_sources.description: Blended Meteosat infrared, microwave (AMSU, SSM/I) and GTS rain gauge data over Africa.

data_sources.name: NOAA STAR Vegetation Health Index (VHI / VCI / TCI)
data_sources.agency: NOAA Center for Satellite Applications and Research (STAR)
data_sources.description: Vegetation Condition Index (VCI) and Temperature Condition Index (TCI) for agricultural drought stress.

data_sources.name: NOAA NCEP Climate Forecast System Version 2 (CFSv2)
data_sources.description: Coupled ocean-atmosphere-land dynamical seasonal ensemble predictions for 1-9 month lead times.

data_sources.name: NASA Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) IMERG Early Run
data_sources.description: Real-time satellite multi-sensor precipitation estimation providing fast early warning telemetry.

data_sources.name: Climate Hazards Center InfraRed Precipitation with Stations (CHIRPS)
data_sources.latency: CHIRPS-Prelim (~2 days); Final (~3rd of next month)
data_sources.description: High-resolution rainfall dataset designed specifically for drought monitoring in Africa.

data_sources.name: Ethiopian Meteorological Institute (EMI) Ground Weather Stations
data_sources.spatial_resolution: Point locations (Yechila Abergelle, Tekeze Basin, Tigray, Wag Hemra)
data_sources.description: Ground truth observations: rainfall, min/max temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, solar radiation.
